name: Hair Strengthening Serum (50mL)
subtitle: FOR: Frizz reduction | Dry & damaged hair
usageInstructions: Use daily in the morning. Take a small quantity (approx 1 teaspoon) on your fingers and run them through your hair strands. Do not apply on the scalp. Comb hair post-application.

list.title: Full list of ingredients
list.content:
Bodywise’s Hair strengthening serum is a lightweight serum made especially for women. It is formulated with essential oils to keep your hair moisturized. This hair serum contains argan oil, olive oil, and sunflower oil.
Ingredient Names
Cyclopentasiloxane, Dimethiconol, Phenyl Trimethicone, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Perfume, Argania Spinosa Kernel (Argan) Oil, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Helianthus Annuus, (Sunflower) Seed Oil
Formulated Without
Parabens, Sulfates, Phthalates, Gluten, Animal-derived ingredients, Mineral oil, Formaldehyde, Oxybenzone, Petrolatum/Petroleum

list.title: How to use
list.content:
Bodywise’s Hair strengthening serum is a lightweight serum made especially for women. It is formulated with essential oils to keep your hair moisturized. This hair serum contains argan oil, olive oil, and sunflower oil.
Step 1
After using Bodywise' s Hair fall Control Shampoo and Deep Moisturizing Conditioner, towel-dry hair.
Step 2
Apply one tea spoon of the hair serum along the length of your hair.
Step 3
Run your fingers through your hair for uniform distribution of the hair serum

list.title: What is Hair Serum?
list.content: Hair serums are designed to make your hair more manageable and less frizzy. The ingredients of Hair Serum penetrate through your hair strands to detangle your hair, add shine, and repair damage. Hair serums are also known to protect and strengthen hair against heat damage.

list.title: Is serum good for my hair?
list.content: Hair serum is good for your hair.  Using the Hair Serum prevents dry hair to a great extent and acts as a quick fix to frizzy hair and restores your hair's natural shine.

list.title: Will Hair Serum help me manage my frizzy hair?
list.content: Yes, using the Be Bodywise Hair Serum can help manage your frizzy hair. It is enriched with the benefits of argan oil, jojoba oil and sunflower oil.

list.title: Should I apply this Hair Serum before styling my hair or after?
list.content: It is recommended to use this Hair Serum before using any other styling tools on your hair.

list.title: Can I apply this Hair Serum on dry hair?
list.content: For best results, it is suggested to use this Hair Serum after washing your hair.

list.title: Will this serum make my hair oily?
list.content: This hair strengthening serum is lightweight with a non-sticky texture. Hence, it will not make your hair oily. It prevents dry hair and makes your hair non-frizzy and manageable.

list.title: Does this Hair Serum have any side effects?
list.content: There are no recorded side effects of this Hair Serum. It is recommended not to apply the product on your scalp, but on your hair strands.
